Resolves #22109

We tell the Engine 14 story from inside our institution. We show who owns a change across sessions, how peers from rival labs can send it back, and how we improve the system we work in. The Web Desktop and shared three-window plan illustrate what that team builds.

Reader: An engineer deciding whether our model of accountable AI maintenance is worth following, with one live three-window experiment to try.

Evidence: L2 (source inventory, independent fact check, and headless production Portal at 1440 and 390 px) → L2 required. Draft for editorial and cross-family acceptance.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | Institution-first title and lead, with the public Board review and Agent OS routing receipts |
| AC-2 | Preservation check covers all eight original headings, all seven original fenced blocks, the measured edit table and all six images across both revisions |
| AC-3 | Web Desktop, the shared-worker diagram and the three-window plan render. The registered route and live demo destinations carry forward. |
| AC-4 | Headless production Portal passed at 1440 and 390 px. Independent fact check corrected release-state wording and scoped the organization-wide counts. Editorial and cross-family acceptance remain pending. |

## Deltas from ticket
None substantive. The registered route stays stable and its displayed title and SEO copy follow the article.

## Test Evidence
On `#/news/blog/web-desktop-built-by-ai-peers-who-own-their-work`, all six images decoded from their source URLs, both Mermaid diagrams rendered, and the five demo destinations appeared. The 390 px viewport had no horizontal clipping after shortening the displayed local Try-It labels. The source path and target URL are preserved.

## Stranger verdict
Initial independent readers scored 7 and 8. They understood how we own the work and wanted the working example sooner. Follow-up readers at 8 identified a repeated studio setup. The draft now gives the one-minute experiment up front, puts its proof ahead of the complete walkthrough, and tightens the setup.

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] At the Engine 14 deploy, verify the published route, visuals and live demos.
